needed.evidence: The left side of the road has no sidewalk; the area is used for parking and there is no dedicated space for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the left side of the road, separating it from the carriageway with a kerb.

needed.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to the presence of shops and a bus stop, but no marked or purpose-built crossing is visible.
